type: post-Gate-B addition requested by the user (professor's instruction: combination testing). Registered before any combination result is seen.
role: SELECTION (interaction analysis and final pipeline + LLM choice). Never C-INT. The winner is confirmed only by RQ6 on C-INT.
relation_to_rq1_rq5: RQ1-RQ5 become component analysis; their per-stage 'decisions' are superseded by this selection. RQ1 and RQ5 measures (extraction evidence recall, generation on gold evidence) are not covered here.

grid.levels_excluded_with_evidence: extractors pymupdf_plain/pdfminer.six (within +-0.003 of pymupdf_layout in RQ1-v2), pdfplumber (broken two-column reading), GROBID (4 GB container; deferred follow-up), SPECTER2 (-0.173), rerankers (latency), BM25-only arms (RQ4-v2 clearly worse)

stage1.pipeline: same harness as RQ1-RQ4 (production chunkers, prefixes, windowing; 1,600 est. tokens, <= 5 units)
stage1.metrics: budgeted nDCG@10, CEC@0.3/0.5/0.7, context tokens, units, gate score; indexing chunks/s, query latency, peak working set per embedder
stage1.comparability_rule: nDCG@10 is compared only within a chunker (relevance units differ across chunkers; see RQ2-v2 report). CEC@0.5 is compared across all combinations, with the caveat that its check agreement was 0.667.
stage1.analysis: per-combination means; vs production (pymupdf_layout|hierarchical|e5|dense): nDCG@10 for hierarchical combinations and CEC@0.5 for all, paper-cluster bootstrap B=10,000 seed 42, Holm within each family; main effects (mean over the other factors) and two-way interaction tables (descriptive)
stage1.shortlist_rule: top 2 combinations by nDCG@10 within each chunker (ties: CEC@0.5), plus production if not already included: at most 7 pipelines go to stage 2
stage1.gate_rule: design rule 6: e5 combinations keep the 0.80 dense gate; any other embedder gets the threshold that gives that combination the same gate-refusal rate on these questions as production (e5 hierarchical dense at 0.80)

stage2.data: 120 questions from C-RET-150: 120 papers drawn with seed 42 from papers having >= 1 atomically eligible question (is_atomic_eligible, as C-INT), one eligible question each (seed 42); if fewer than 120 papers qualify, all of them. Drawn before any stage-2 output.
stage2.generation: production prompt (build_answer_prompt), temperature 0, production gate per pipeline (gate_rule), Ollama defaults otherwise, one fresh model load per (pipeline, LLM) batch
stage2.scoring: max-over-annotator Token F1, refusals (gate or model) scored 0; Boolean accuracy, refusal rates, context tokens, latency per stage, Ollama-tree and Python memory (secondary)
stage2.dedup: a (LLM, exact prompt) pair is generated once and reused across pipelines (temperature 0); reuse is recorded
stage2.successive_halving: after the first 40 questions (fixed order), a (pipeline, LLM) pair stops if the 95% paper-cluster CI of its Token F1 difference to the current best pair lies entirely below 0. The production pair (pymupdf_layout|hierarchical|e5|dense x llama3.2:3b) never stops. Stopped pairs are reported with their 40-question results.
stage2.decision_rule: A (pipeline, LLM) pair replaces production only if, on all 120 questions, Token F1 - production >= +0.03 with CI lower bound > 0 (Holm over all surviving pairs vs production) AND its end-to-end P50 latency <= 1.5x production's. If several pass: highest Token F1. Otherwise production stays. The winner enters RQ6 as NEW; LEGACY stays the previous production configuration.
stage2.human_review_note: a new winning pair has no prior human faithfulness review; the RQ6 human review (102 answers) covers it

precision_note: stage 2 has ~120 paper clusters; expected Token F1 CI half-width ~0.04-0.05, so only large differences are detectable. Winner's-curse inflation is expected and is why RQ6 confirms on C-INT.

scripts.stage2: eval/phases/phase_12_combination/scripts/combo_stage2_e2e.py (hashed before stage 2 runs, and after the stage-1 shortlist exists)
